CustomObject.description: Hands out new establishment certification numbers: 77 followed by a counter, as in the previous system. Decide creates one record each time a salon, threading facility or alternative hair design facility gets its first license; the record's auto-number is the establishment's new Certification Number. Each record also shows which establishment it went to. Never delete or edit these records: the auto-number is what keeps two establishments from getting the same number. The counter starts above the highest number loaded from the previous system; before go-live, check it is still above the last number that system issued.
CustomObject.label: Establishment Number Counter
